column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
fs.test.ts: each Node error code becomes its class with code, path and cause
fs.test.ts: every call on a real temporary folder, the refusals
proc.test.ts: both platforms' rules and file URLs
fs-more.test.ts: readDir async, chown, symlinkSync
fs-more.test.ts: file handles, seek, streams, using
fs-more.test.ts: copy and walk
fs.test.ts: a folder linked as a junction is read through it
dirs.test.ts: the folders on Linux, macOS and Windows from the environment, the XDG variables honored, macOS as Linux, no home no folder
proc.test.ts: the environment, the platform's names, which, a program with its input and output
the library's tests of spawn: streams in and out, kill, status, NotFound
the library's tests of spawn: ppid, build.target, unrefTimer, selfCommand
discover.test.ts: programs found by prefix, first wins, shadowed ones kept with why
compile.test.ts: the arguments and a small program built and run
git.test.ts: HEAD, cleanliness, changed paths and files at a revision in a temporary repository
the lock's tests in commons' suite: one run at a time, the holder named, a stale lock
watch.test.ts: events joined, recursive, stopped by abort
job-plan.test.ts and schedule.test.ts: exact units, plist and .cmd per OS, quoting round trips
the console's tests of commons' suite: whether a stream is a terminal, raw mode, colour, emoji and width
the standard streams' tests of commons' suite: stdin, stdout and stderr as streams, bytes or text
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the tarball and runs every entry on Node 26 and Bun and type-checks a consumer
